title: L1 — Auto layout and grids
exercises: layout mode, padding, spacing, alignment, wrap, sizing modes, absolute children, LayoutGrid
record: the exact padding, gap, sizes and alignment values
notes: L1a row: HORIZONTAL, padding 16, gap 12, primary and counter alignment CENTER, fixed 320 × 96; items 40 × 40, 40 × 64, 40 × 24.
L1b column: VERTICAL, padding 16, gap 8, width fixed 200, height hug; L1b fill child fills the width.
L1c wrap: HORIZONTAL wrap, width fixed 200, padding 8, gap 8, row gap 8, six 48 × 48 items.
L1d absolute: HORIZONTAL, padding 16, gap 12, hug both; L1d absolute child ABSOLUTE at (100, 8).
L1e minmax: fixed 320 × 96, padding 16; L1e bounded child fills both axes with min/max width 80/160, height 40/56.
L1f grids: 4 columns (stretch, gutter 16, margin 16) and 3 rows (stretch, gutter 8, margin 8). L1g hug: hug both axes, padding 12, gap 8.
